### 新增

- **凭证加密与凭证库引用**：SSH 主机的密码 / 私钥 / 口令，以及 MCP 令牌、WebDAV / S3 密码、TTS / ASR 密钥改为**加密落盘**（与模型 API 密钥同一加密通道，兼容既有的明文旧数据）；设置页密钥输入统一为「引用凭证库 / 粘贴入库」两种方式；入库自动带描述，引用提示补充换机恢复说明；凭证库新增分组与排序。
- **网段输入组件**：Web 服务器、AI 调试接口、本地 MCP 三处统一为「输入框 + 常用网段快捷项（点选 / 删除 / 保存当前）」。
- **本地文件访问白名单**：浏览器加载本地文件只放行技能目录；被拦截时显示说明页并记录日志（此前是空白响应，看不出原因）。
- **凭证库 App 内密码**：设备未设锁屏或指纹时，可用 App 内密码解锁凭证库（加盐哈希存储，不依赖设备密钥，换机后可重设）。
- **流式空闲看门狗**：流式响应卡住时自动断开并走重试，不再无限等待。
- **换机迁移包（跨设备）与云端中转**：把**会话、设置与助手**导出成"换台设备也能读"的迁移包（包内数据在本机解密后用备份口令重新加密）；可导出成本地文件，也可上传云端（WebDAV）中转（云端只保留最新一份）；导入前会自动做一次本机备份作为回滚点；工作区文件、rootfs **与凭证库不在迁移范围**，导入后如需请重装工作区 rootfs，凭证请按后文「已知问题与迁移建议」用凭证库导出 / 导入迁移。
- **设备诊断 DNS 检查增强**：显示国际域名解析结果；常见公共 DNS（阿里 / 腾讯 / 114 / Google / Cloudflare）逐个测速并显示最快的一个；开 VPN 时也能列出可用 DNS。
- **工作区资源画像持久化**：大工作区（数万文件）的采集结果落盘、启动恢复、24 小时静默重采 + 手动强制刷新。

### 实验性功能

- **chroot 沙箱后端（实验，需 root 设备）**：工作区可切换 chroot 执行后端——没有 ptrace 模拟开销、glibc 发行版语义完整（解决 proot 下的 syscall 语义偏差与 loader/兼容问题）；开启前自动能力自检（root / SELinux 域 / 挂载 / chroot / 跨命名空间，失败即拒绝并给出原因）；工作区文件区自动挂载进 chroot，工具语义与 proot 后端保持一致；默认关闭、显式开启。
  - 本轮增强：挂载常驻复用（连续命令不再每条重复挂载，多命令任务明显更快）；卸载随「关闭开关 / 删除工作区」自动清理；后端未就绪时在开关下方明确提示"实际仍在用 proot"，不再静默回退。
- **AI 调试接口（实验，默认关闭）**：仅本机监听 + 令牌门禁（凭证库引用 / 自定义 / 自动生成），提供状态与只读日志端点，请求全程留审计；监听范围可选（仅本机 / 局域网 / 自定义网段 / 全部）。

### 修复

- **进入会话列表闪退**（依赖注入缺少接口注册）。
- 工作区资源统计：符号链接导致遍历死循环、详情页长期显示「-」。
- 打开 / 导出工作区大文件时界面无响应：操作移入后台并显示进行中状态，失败直接提示错误。
- 备份 / 迁移包导入大文件时界面卡死（zip 拷贝、回滚点加密等长操作后台化）。
- SSH：认证失败、远端平台判定失败、跳板解析失败现在都带**原因**（不再只有一句"认证失败"）；主机名引用写法容错。
- AI 调试接口：端口被占用导致启动即崩；口令引用无效时拒绝启动并记录原因；启动失败自动复位开关；页面显示实际监听端口与口令来源。
- chroot：无 root 时 su 异常不再崩溃；开启失败提示改为本地化文案；辅助脚本改为按内容刷新（此前「文件已存在即跳过」，导致已安装用户拿不到修好的脚本）。
- OAuth 回调端口在起服务前先探测可用性。
- 云端迁移包上传的调用与函数名不一致。
- 设置页快捷入口首帧闪动；启动恢复与首次采集的竞态。
- Debian rootfs 预置地址过期后自动解析最新构建目录。

### 变更

- chroot 内命令以 **root** 运行（仅限已 root 设备，用户自担风险；默认关闭 + 能力自检把关）。

### 已知问题与迁移建议

- **迁移包换机恢复后需重启 App**：恢复完成后请手动重启一次，让数据与缓存重新加载。
- **凭证不做迁移包迁移**：迁移包只带会话、设置与助手；**换机搬凭证请用「凭证库导出 / 导入」**（凭证库页面导出成文件 → 新机导入即可用）。这也避开了一条平台限制：凭证是设备加密态数据，直接跨机搬只会得到空值。
- **提供商密钥的加密范围后续可能调整**：后续版本可能改为「只加密 API key、不再整体加密提供商配置」；届时需要**重建提供商配置**，或改为**引用凭证库中的密钥**。
  - 建议：现在就把各提供商的 API key **存进凭证库**（设置页密钥输入支持"粘贴入库"），将来能平滑切换。

### English

#### What's New

- **Credential encryption & vault references**: SSH host password / private key / passphrase, plus MCP tokens, WebDAV / S3 passwords and TTS / ASR keys are now encrypted at rest (same channel as model API keys; existing plaintext data keeps working). Secret inputs across settings are unified as "reference a vault entry / paste into the vault"; new vault entries get an automatic description; reference hints now mention cross-device recovery; the vault gains groups and sorting.
- **Network CIDR input component**: the web server, the AI debug API and local MCP now share one input with quick-pick CIDR presets (tap to add, remove, or save the current one).
- **Local file access allow-list**: the browser only loads local files from the skills directory; blocked requests now show an explanatory page and are logged (previously a blank response).
- **In-app vault password**: when the device has no lock screen or biometrics, the vault can be unlocked with an in-app password (salted hash, not tied to device keys; can be reset after switching devices).
- **Streaming idle watchdog**: a stalled stream is aborted and retried instead of waiting forever.
- **Cross-device migration package & cloud transfer**: export **chats, settings and assistants** into a package another device can read (contents are decrypted locally and re-encrypted with your backup password). Export to a local file or upload to WebDAV (only the latest is kept); a local backup is created automatically before import as a rollback point. Workspace files, the rootfs **and the vault are out of scope** — reinstall the workspace rootfs after importing if needed, and move credentials with vault export / import as described under "Known Issues & Migration Tips".
- **Device diagnostics: DNS checks improved**: international domain resolution results, common public DNS servers speed-tested individually with the fastest shown, and available DNS servers listed even when a VPN is on.
- **Workspace resource profile persistence**: profiles for large workspaces (tens of thousands of files) are persisted, restored on startup, silently re-collected every 24 hours, and can be force-refreshed manually.

#### Experimental

- **chroot sandbox backend (experimental, rooted devices only)**: workspaces can switch to a chroot execution backend — no ptrace emulation overhead, full glibc distro semantics. A capability self-check (root / SELinux domain / mount / chroot / cross-namespace) runs before enabling and refuses to start with a reason on failure. The workspace files area is mounted into the chroot so tools behave the same as with the proot backend. Off by default; opt-in.
  - New in this release: mounts are kept alive and reused (consecutive commands no longer re-mount every time — noticeably faster for multi-command tasks); mounts are cleaned up when the switch is turned off or a workspace is deleted; when the backend is unavailable the settings page now says so explicitly ("still running on proot") instead of silently falling back.
- **AI debug API (experimental, off by default)**: localhost-only listener with token gating (vault reference / custom / auto-generated), status and read-only log endpoints, full audit trail; listen scope selectable (localhost / LAN / custom CIDR / all).

#### Fixes

- **Crash when opening the conversation list** (missing DI registration).
- Workspace resource statistics: symlink loops during traversal; the detail page no longer shows "-" forever.
- Opening / exporting large workspace files no longer freezes the UI: work is moved to the background with progress shown, and failures surface an error.
- Freezing while importing large backup / migration packages.
- SSH: authentication failures, remote platform detection and jump-host resolution now report a reason (previously just "authentication failed"); host-name references are more tolerant.
- AI debug API: crash when the port was busy; startup refused with a logged reason when the token reference is invalid; the switch auto-resets after a failed start; the page shows the actual listening port and token source.
- chroot: su exceptions on non-rooted devices no longer crash; failure messages localized; helper scripts are now refreshed by content (previously "skip if the file exists", which left installed users on stale scripts).
- OAuth callback port is probed before starting the server.
- Cloud migration-package upload called a mismatched function name.
- Settings quick-entry grid flicker on first frame; race between startup restore and first collection.
- Debian rootfs preset URLs expired: the latest build directory is now resolved automatically.

#### Changes

- Commands inside chroot run as **root** (rooted devices only; off by default, guarded by capability checks; use at your own risk).

#### Known Issues & Migration Tips

- **Restart the app after restoring a migration package**: restart once after the import so data and caches are reloaded.
- **Credentials are not moved by the migration package**: it carries chats, settings and assistants only; **use vault export / import to move credentials across devices** (export to a file from the vault page, then import on the new device). This also sidesteps a platform limitation: vault entries are device-encrypted, so copying them across devices directly only yields empty values.
- **Provider encryption scope may change in a future release**: later versions may encrypt only the API key instead of the whole provider configuration; when that happens you will need to rebuild the provider configuration, or reference the key from the vault.
  - Recommendation: store provider API keys **in the vault now** (secret inputs support "paste into the vault"), so the switch is seamless.
